notes:
Summary: Qualified enterprise retailer analytics vendor. POC completed; technical fit good (latency and throughput met POC targets) but lost procurement decision to hyperscaler-managed endpoints. Key factors: centralized cloud governance, existing AWS enterprise discount, and departure of the internal champion.

POC and technical notes:
- POC ran 2-node dedicated pool, measured p95 latencies ~120ms for chat scenario, throughput targets achieved.
- SE demonstrated routing fallback and KV cache savings; product liked model-version pinning and rollout controls.
- Security asked for KMS/HSM integration and iso27001 evidence — Redwood provided docs and a sandbox KMS demo.

Procurement/security insights (quotes/paraphrases):
- "We have a blanket policy to consolidate inference under hyperscaler managed endpoints for accounting and key management" — Head of Cloud Governance 2026-01-27.
- "Discounting/commitments with AWS make third-party inference platforms a hard sell" — Procurement 2026-01-20.

Internal dynamics and blockers:
- Internal champion (Sr. ML Eng) left company 2026-02-01 — momentum stalled.
- CFO put a temporary freeze on new third-party platform spend until Q4.
- Security team prioritized use of hyperscaler-managed endpoints to reduce tool surface and centralize audit flows.

Next steps / playbook items:
- Mark as closed-lost to AWS; file win/loss notes with Product and Sales Ops.
- Send short exit survey and a one-page comparison (latency/cost tradeoffs) to procurement — keep light, ask permission to check back in Q4 2026.
- Capture POC metrics and screenshots in shared folder for future competitive enablement.
